verdict.rationale: Remote documents registrable outbound webhooks that push events to your endpoint, with sandbox test deliveries, signature verification, and CLI management of subscriptions with delivery history and replays. The only event type shown in evidence is a company EOR hiring verification event, plus a general note that webhooks push workforce changes. None of the story's named payroll lifecycle events are evidenced. missing for 10: documented payroll-processed, employee-onboarded and payment-failed event types, a full event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payroll lifecycle events (payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations

citations.quote: A webhook lets Remote push events to your application the moment something changes, so you do not have to poll the API.
Fire test deliveries against your endpoint in Sandbox before you register a production callback.
company.eor_hiring.verification_completed ... When company verification is complete.
manage departments, custom fields, and webhook subscriptions, including delivery history and replays.
load the full list once, then let webhooks push you the changes.
